statements.impact_statement: The affected tar extraction helper is vendored in setuptools; the offline vllm serve runtime does not build or extract Python packages.
The affected sdist MANIFEST.in build path is not invoked by the offline vllm serve runtime; setuptools remains only to satisfy the pinned vLLM package contract.
The affected malicious-wheel unpack path is a vendored setuptools build utility and is not invoked by the offline vllm serve runtime.
NVD identifies the affected configuration as PyTorch 2.6.0; this exact image contains PyTorch 2.11.0+gitd0c8b1f.
